standard_prerequisites.name: The accessibility family
standard_prerequisites.statement: Accessible elements of a set under a binary relation form an inductive family: an element is accessible as soon as every element below it is accessible, and any accessibility witness is built from a function choosing witnesses below.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof is an induction on one witness and then a second induction on the other, with the constructors of this family in both roles.

standard_prerequisites.name: Function extensionality
standard_prerequisites.statement: Two functions are equal as soon as they agree on every argument.
standard_prerequisites.use: It reduces the final equality of two accessibility witnesses to a pointwise equality of their chosen witnesses below.

core_obligations: State the goal: for every element a and any two accessibility witnesses s1 and s2 for a, the two witnesses are equal (source line 932).

Induct on the first witness with the motive that quantifies over the second witness, and expose the data of the constructor: a function h1 choosing witnesses for every element below a and a coherence k1 for it (source lines 933-937).

Treat the resulting statement as a family in the element and the second witness and perform a second induction on that witness, which supplies h2 and a further coherence k2 whose type the author calls monstrous but irrelevant (source lines 938-945).
Reduce the goal to the equality of the two chosen-witness functions, which by function extensionality follows from the first coherence k1 (source lines 953-956).

proof_roadmap.step: Goal and the motive for the induction on the first witness.
Expose the first constructor data and set up the second induction.
Second constructor data, then function extensionality and the coherence k1.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled author lem environment at source lines 928-930: accessibility is a mere property. The proof (source lines 931-957) is a double induction and is not visible in the statement: it first inducts on one accessibility witness with a motive that keeps the other witness quantified, exposing the chosen-witness function and its coherence, then recognises the resulting goal as a family in the element and the second witness and inducts again, and finally reduces the comparison of the two witnesses to the pointwise equality of their chosen-witness functions, which function extensionality and the first coherence discharge. Two nested inductions on the same inductive family plus the extensionality step are the substance, and the statement alone shows none of them.
